title: red-pipeline --job reads a started-then-canceled job as passed, so a red-main bug's repro turns green
goal: ql_deliver.job_ran leaves out a canceled job, and red-pipeline --job reads only a pipeline where the job ended success or failed on its own account, so a bug's repro stays failing when someone starts and cancels the job; a test plants a canceled kb-tests with started_at newer than a red one. From the SP-z7a5c76b review.
